trans-unit.source: Create your chatbot for free at webchatagent.com, let it learn your website and copy its ID into the field below. Free plan available, higher limits and more features with a paid plan.
Design, texts and knowledge of your chatbot are managed in the WebChatAgent dashboard. Changes show up on the website right away.

The chat then appears on every page of this site. Find the ID in the chatbot dashboard: open the chatbot, choose "Chatbot actions", then "Copy chatbot ID". Example: 3f2b9c1e-8a7d-4e5f-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c. Leave empty to switch the chat off.
Pass logged-in website users to the chat

If a visitor is logged in to this website, the chat receives their name, email address and username. It can greet them by name and does not ask for contact details again. Mention this in your privacy policy.
Usually leave empty. Only fill in if your chatbot provider gives you its own address, for example https://chat.example-agency.com
Hide the chat button on this page and all subpages
Inline chats placed as content elements stay visible. Set it on the root page to hide the chat button on the whole site.
Shows the chat inside the page content, for example on a contact or help page.
Internal name (not shown on the website)
Leave empty to use the chatbot ID of this site (Sites module, tab "Chat"). Example: 3f2b9c1e-8a7d-4e5f-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c
Optional, for example 600px or 80vh. Leave empty and the chat grows with its content.
